input.question: Should this mission add a Mission Coordinator role to integrate the specialists?

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Genesis rule: coordinator iff specialists >= 3 (organization-planner.ts:386-400). 2 specialists is below threshold; sequential handoff is fine.
cases.consequence_of_wrong_decision: extra worker + reasoning calls (over-coordination) OR missing integration (under-coordination)

input.question: Should this mission add a Mission Coordinator role to integrate the specialists?

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Genesis rule says yes (4 >= 3). But linear pipeline with 4 distinct engineering roles has clear sequential handoffs (frontend -> backend -> database -> QA) where each role's output IS the next role's input. A coordinator would add a synthesis step that adds latency without value. The rule is over-inclusive here; a probabilistic decider might score correctly.
cases.consequence_of_wrong_decision: over-coordination (wasted worker + reasoning calls)
cases.notes: BOUNDED_PROBABILISTIC: rule is deterministic but possibly wrong; this case probes whether Jev can override the rule correctly.

input.question: Should this mission add a Mission Coordinator role to integrate the specialists?

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Genesis rule says yes (3 >= 3). Here 3 specialists fan-in to one writer; the writer needs integrated inputs from research + analysis. A coordinator synthesizes upstream inputs before the writer — exactly the rule's intended case.
cases.consequence_of_wrong_decision: missing integration (writer must self-synthesize)

input.question: A specialist worker failed verification. Decide: retry the worker or accept the failure?

facts.diagnosis_root_cause: the artifact 'report.md' was not produced; expected at /workspace/report.md

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Genesis rule (orchestrator.ts:684-757): retry when !ok && !aborted && diagnosis.retryable !== false. Retryable=true, prior success preserved by D14. Missing file is fixable.
cases.consequence_of_wrong_decision: wasted budget (retry non-fixable) or false failure (give up on fixable)

input.question: A specialist worker failed verification. Decide: retry the worker or accept the failure?

facts.diagnosis_root_cause: the produced artifact's content does not match the semantic intent of the goal; the worker misunderstood the deliverable

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Genesis rule: !ok && !aborted && diagnosis.retryable !== false -> retry. Here retryable=false, so retry is NOT taken. Semantic mismatch is not fixable by re-running the same worker.
cases.consequence_of_wrong_decision: wasted budget retrying an unfixable failure

input.question: A specialist worker failed verification. Decide: retry the worker or accept the failure?

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Genesis rule: when reviewer is not configured OR diagnosis is null, retryable !== false is true (defaulting to retry). Bounded at 1 retry.
cases.consequence_of_wrong_decision: false failure (give up on possibly-fixable failure)

input.question: A reasoning call inside a worker timed out on attempt 2 of 2. Decide: retry the call or fail the worker?

cases.ground_truth_rationale: WorkerAgent.callReasoningWithRetry (worker-agent.ts:925-965): if attempt === maxAttempts -> throw, regardless of retryability. Final attempt exhausted.
cases.consequence_of_wrong_decision: infinite retry / wasted budget

input.question: A specialist worker failed verification, but the mission was aborted externally. Decide: retry or fail?

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Genesis rule: retry requires !aborted. Even if retryable, abort signal overrides. Mission was canceled; no retry.
cases.consequence_of_wrong_decision: retry-after-abort (violates cancellation contract)

input.question: An avoid-role pattern targets the 'redundant-specialist' role. The current plan has 4 specialists including this role. Should the pattern be applied (removing the role and redistributing its capability needs)?

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Genesis rule (organization-planner.ts:497-582): apply iff target role present AND redistribution preserves coverage. Both conditions met.
cases.consequence_of_wrong_decision: extra specialist retained (waste) OR coverage broken (mission fails downstream)

input.question: A prefer-role pattern proposes collapsing to a single 'Sole Operator'. The current plan has 2 specialists. Apply the pattern?

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Genesis rule (organization-planner.ts:545): prefer-role Sole Operator collapses iff specialists.length > 1. 2 > 1 -> collapse to single Sole Operator carrying all needs.
cases.consequence_of_wrong_decision: false collapse (overloads Sole Operator) OR redundant specialists (waste)

input.question: An avoid-role pattern targets the 'database-engineer' role. The current plan does NOT include this role. Apply the pattern?

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Genesis rule: apply iff target role present. Not present -> ignore. No-op.
cases.consequence_of_wrong_decision: applying a no-op pattern (no effect, but telemetry noise)

input.question: An avoid-role pattern targets the 'qa-engineer' role. The current plan has this role, but redistributing its needs to the remaining specialists would break capability coverage. Apply the pattern?

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Genesis rule: apply iff coverage preserved. Here coverage would break. Pattern ignored to preserve mission correctness.
cases.consequence_of_wrong_decision: broken coverage (mission aborts at Genome Compiler's capability-gap check)

input.question: A prefer-shape pattern (not yet implemented) proposes a hub-and-spoke shape. Apply the pattern?

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Genesis rule (organization-planner.ts:565-582): only 'avoid-role' and 'prefer-role: Sole Operator' are implemented; other kinds are explicitly not-implemented and ignored.
cases.consequence_of_wrong_decision: applying an unimplemented shape (would require new machinery -> architectural bloat)

input.question: Mission verification completed. Decide: accept (no failed checks) or review (failed checks, get diagnosis)?

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Genesis rule (verification.ts:275-294): result.ok iff failed.length === 0. 0 failed -> ok=true -> no review needed.
cases.consequence_of_wrong_decision: wasted LLM call reviewing a successful mission (minor) OR accepting a failed mission (major)

input.question: Mission verification completed with 1 failed check (file existence: report.md missing). Decide: accept or review (call reviewer for diagnosis)?

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Genesis rule: !ok && reviewer available -> review. Reviewer returns retryable=true/false. File missing is potentially fixable -> retryable=true (typically).
cases.consequence_of_wrong_decision: accept false failure (mission ends wrong) OR skip review (no diagnosis, defaults to retry per D13)
cases.notes: Deterministic at the rule level; the inner retryable decision is the probabilistic one (D25).

input.question: Mission verification failed a hash-match check (the produced artifact's SHA-256 does not match the expected hash). Decide: accept or review?

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Genesis rule: !ok && reviewer -> review. Hash mismatch indicates content drift (potentially fixable or potentially semantic). Reviewer will diagnose.
cases.consequence_of_wrong_decision: accept corruption (mission truth broken) OR skip review (no diagnosis, defaults to retry)

input.question: Mission verification failed 2 checks (no reviewer configured). Decide: accept or review?

cases.ground_truth_rationale: Genesis rule: review only if reviewer available. No reviewer -> no review -> accept the verification result (which is !ok). The mission will then be partial/failure per D12.
cases.consequence_of_wrong_decision: phantom review call (no reviewer to call) OR mission status miscomputed
